exercises.q: I look out of the window.
exercises.why: **гляжу** — гляде́ть (imperfective): to look; to look after, to take care of.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **гляди** — гляде́ть (imperfective): to look; to look after, to take care of.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Взгляни** — взгляну́ть (perfective): to glance at, to look at; (figurative) to take a look (at), to pay attention to. Wiktionary: вз- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: I'd like to see that happen.
exercises.ru: Хотел бы я ___, как это произойдёт.
exercises.why: **поглядеть** — погляде́ть (perfective): to look, to glance; to look after, to take care of. Wiktionary: по- + гляде́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **оглянулся** — огляну́ться (perfective): to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at. Wiktionary: огляну́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Оглянись** — огляну́ться (perfective): to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at. Wiktionary: огляну́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **оглядывайся** — огля́дываться (imperfective): to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at something; to look round / around; to have a look around. Wiktionary: огля́дывать + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to glance at, to look at
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: гляде́ть — to look; взгляд — glance, look; взгляну́ть — to glance at, to look at; погляде́ть — to look, to glance.
**оглядывайся** — огля́дываться (imperfective): to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at something; to look round / around; to have a look around. Wiktionary: огля́дывать + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **заглянул** — загляну́ть (perfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: за- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Загляни** — загляну́ть (perfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: за- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Tom kept an eye on the screen.
exercises.why: **поглядывал** — погля́дывать (imperfective): to cast a glance (from time to time); to look (after), to keep an eye (on). Wiktionary: погляде́ть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
